description: This file defines the 'VisibilityObserver' class which listens to browser visibility and focus events to notify an external handler, managing debounce with a timeout.

classes.name: VisibilityObserver
classes.description: A class that observes document and window visibility and focus events, and triggers a callback with debounce.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes event listeners for visibility change and focus events, binding internal handlers.

methods.name: onVisibilityChange
methods.description: Handler invoked when document visibility changes, determines the event type and notifies.

methods.name: onFocusEvent
methods.description: Handler invoked when window focus occurs, triggers a focus event notification.

methods.name: notifyEvent
methods.description: Triggers the provided callback with debounce, clearing previous timeout if any.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes event listeners and disables event notification.
